mapper.select: SELECT id,tenant_id,order_no,store_id,quote_id,current_status,estimated_fee,current_fee,confirmed_fee,currency,chargeable_weight,version,created_at FROM shipment_order WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{orderId}

SELECT fa.id,fa.shipment_order_id,o.store_id,fa.adjustment_type,fa.before_amount,fa.after_amount,fa.difference_amount,fa.currency,fa.confirmation_status,fa.requested_at,fa.confirmed_at FROM fee_adjustment fa JOIN shipment_order o ON o.id=fa.shipment_order_id AND o.tenant_id=fa.tenant_id WHERE fa.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND fa.shipment_order_id=#{orderId} AND fa.id=#{adjustmentId}

SELECT fa.id,fa.shipment_order_id,o.store_id,fa.adjustment_type,fa.before_amount,fa.after_amount,fa.difference_amount,fa.currency,fa.confirmation_status,fa.requested_at,fa.confirmed_at FROM fee_adjustment fa JOIN shipment_order o ON o.id=fa.shipment_order_id AND o.tenant_id=fa.tenant_id WHERE fa.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND fa.shipment_order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY fa.id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE fee_adjustment SET confirmation_status='REQUESTED',requested_by=#{userId},requested_at=#{requestedAt} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND shipment_order_id=#{orderId} AND id=#{adjustmentId} AND adjustment_type='INCREASE' AND confirmation_status='PENDING_CONFIRMATION' AND confirmed_by IS NULL

UPDATE shipment_order SET confirmed_fee=#{expectedFee},current_status='READY_FOR_OUTBOUND',version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{orderId} AND current_status='PENDING_PRICE_CONFIRMATION' AND current_fee=#{expectedFee} AND version=#{version}

UPDATE fee_adjustment SET confirmation_status='CONFIRMED',confirmed_by=#{userId},confirmed_at=#{confirmedAt} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND shipment_order_id=#{orderId} AND id=#{adjustmentId} AND adjustment_type='INCREASE' AND after_amount=#{expectedFee} AND confirmed_by IS NULL AND confirmation_status IN ('PENDING_CONFIRMATION','REQUESTED')
